title: Camera estimate + separate moving parts · experimental
disclosure: Meta reasoning and SAM 3.1 separate moving parts from ordinary footage. Local MoGe-2 estimates an unvalidated camera assumption from up to three training frames per component; local reconstruction is recomputed with that camera. Inconsistent estimates and unsupported geometry remain recorded. This experimental option has not demonstrated better geometry than the original camera mode. Camera estimation adds no hosted request. The shared $100 local estimated API allowance still applies.
